reference.use: Read-only assembled baseline. SourcePatches tests compose the candidate in memory and verify reference contents remain unchanged.

files_changed_scope: Service/translation port inventory, extended with account-bound proxy integration and backend-host fixtures. Native and device verification remain separate.

original_evidence.finding: Original managers accept history/onChunk/completion and support model discovery. Gemini uses generateContent; Groq's conversation request is an SSE stream.
v5 histories are JSONEncoder Data containing role/text entries, user/model roles for both providers, with a 200-entry nonstreaming retention limit. The format has no account, dates or model metadata.
Original localTranslationEnabled dispatches eligible neutral text to translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single. It is Google client-side HTTPS; non-neutral tone follows Telegram's structured API.

With Translation is a send-menu action gated by localTranslationEnabled AND translateBeforeSending and nonempty input. Completion installs translated text or the original text on failure, then queues native send with the selected effect. It is not an interception of normal Send.
Outgoing target: stored nonempty target first, otherwise device preferred language; when the detected text matches it, choose English, or Russian for English device language.
Local/voice flags use preference Bool getters, target is optional, and the Siri warning getter is unconditionally true.

voiceTranslationEnabled selects the Apple speech-transcription path for voice/video notes. The Siri notice records the independent dismissal before presentation. The earlier inventory's transcript-text-only interpretation was incorrect.

Absent provider defaults to Gemini; model defaults are gemini-3-flash-preview and llama-3.3-70b-versatile; both proxy getters default true. Gemini also has an original allow-list fallback; the port retains explicit custom model values instead of rewriting them.

VirusTotal's fixed probe is https://vk.com, direct-upload threshold is 32 MiB, and original requests use signed Whitegram proxy authorization. Upload URL responses rewrite the official API prefix to the proxy base.

authorizedRequest(proxyProvider:providerKey:path:method:contentType:accept:) constructs /v1/proxy/<provider>/<path>; applyAuthorization checks session/beta access and adds X-Provider-Key without replacing signed Whitegram Authorization.

showSiriTranscriptionWarning: constant true with independent persistent dismissal, not a disable switch.

ai_proxy: absent/malformed proxy preferences select the account-bound signed adapter. Missing session/access/signing state fails explicitly; only Boolean false selects Direct API.

backend_coordination.status: WhitegramServiceProxyTransport consumes WhitegramBackendAuthorizedTransport for provider headers, preserved status bodies, SSE and body-file uploads. Native fixtures supplied; no live request performed.
backend_coordination.account_binding: WhitegramAccountServices uses Telegram CloudUser numeric IDs. Both service coordinators retain account clients and expose Connect / Refresh Whitegram Access. Optional account parameters preserve direct call sites; omitted accounts cannot use proxy mode.
backend_coordination.upload_urls: Official /api/v3/ and signed /v1/proxy/virustotal/v3/ destinations normalize to the backend origin with separate query items. Direct-only /_ah/upload/ URLs are rejected; the historical large-file response namespace still needs device verification.
requirements: Forward credentials as X-Provider-Key while retaining Whitegram Authorization, session/device signatures, beta access checks and pinned TLS.
Preserve status/body/Retry-After, especially VirusTotal 404 NotFoundError; do not turn an arbitrary 404 into an unknown clean report.
Supply serial SSE chunks and completion for Groq, and disk-backed multipart upload/progress for VirusTotal.
An upload transport must complete only after it has stopped reading bodyFile, including cancellation; its completion closure owns the snapshot.

Bind the provider request to an explicit Telegram CloudUser ID and reject changed sessions. Callers must pass WhitegramAccountServices to the preference-aware wrappers for proxy mode; do not infer an arbitrary active account.
Verify forwarded Gemini/Groq paths and queries with the authenticated historical server. Never retry a rejected proxy request against Direct API.
